claim: Web Summit's public schedule contains 1,122 sessions, running from Monday 9 to Thursday 12 November.
All 17 Cybersecurity Summit sessions are on Thursday 12 November, on Stage 8.
All 16 PITCH sessions are on Tuesday 10 November, on Stage 12.
The PITCH sessions end with results at 16:45.
Opening Night is on Monday 9 November, at Centre Stage at 18:00.
There are 22 Night Summit meet and greets on Monday 9 November.
The session counts in the table are a snapshot of Web Summit's public schedule as it stood on Saturday 7 November.
The table shows 14 of the schedule's 30 tracks.
The Growth Summit has 26 sessions on Wednesday 11 November, on Stage 9.
The Venture Summit is on Stage 5 and has 14 sessions on Tuesday 10 November and 12 on Wednesday 11 November.
The Health Summit, SaaS Summit and Cybersecurity Summit each run only on Thursday 12 November.
The companies page lists 30 companies in security, 22 in AI agents, 18 in developer tools and 15 in governance, risk and compliance.
